skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Experience in climbing, swimming, jumping, lifting, carrying, forcing obstacles, and sustained physical exertion.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Athletics applies Prowess for forceful physical action and Resilience for sustained exertion. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Finesse
skills.description: Experience in balance, stealth, manual precision, lockpicking, concealment, and sleight of hand.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Finesse applies Prowess for agile execution and Composure for patient, steady precision. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Experience in travel, tracking, hunting, weather, fieldcraft, exposure, and practical treatment in the wild.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Survival applies Intuition for reading the environment and Resilience for enduring it. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Craft
skills.description: Experience in constructing, repairing, appraising, salvaging, and manipulating tools and mechanisms.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Craft applies Intellect for design and diagnosis and Prowess for forceful fabrication. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Experience with history, cultures, creatures, religion, magic, relics, symbols, and scholarly traditions.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Lore applies Intellect for learned knowledge and Intuition for interpreting incomplete or unfamiliar signs. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Experience in finding evidence, reconstructing events, testing explanations, appraisal, and methodical inquiry.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Investigation applies Intellect for methodical deduction and Intuition for rapid synthesis. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Experience in noticing danger, detail, motion, sound, hidden features, and changes in the environment.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Perception applies Intuition for immediate awareness and Composure for patient observation. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Empathy
skills.description: Experience in understanding emotion, recognising motives, listening, calming, reassuring, and connecting with others.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Empathy applies Composure for emotional awareness and steadiness and Presence for active connection or reassurance. Each check names the approach it uses.

skills.name: Influence
skills.description: Experience in persuasion, intimidation, negotiation, deception, command, and maintaining a social performance.
skills.descriptionNVSystem: Influence applies Presence for direct social force and Composure for patient negotiation or deception. Each check names the approach it uses.

campaignSpecificSkills.description: Campaign-specific expertise should normally use practices or content tags rather than expanding the core skill list.
